description: Sample Islamic Rulings and Adhkaar (Remembrances) - Multi-language support

items.text_ar: الحمد لله حمداً كثيراً طيباً مباركاً فيه
items.text_en: All praise is due to Allah with abundant, good, and blessed praise
Glory be to Allah and Praise be to Him
I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him

items.text_ar: الحمد لله الذي أمسينا وأمسى الملك لله
items.text_en: All praise is due to Allah for reaching the evening

items.text_ar: يا حي يا قيوم برحمتك أستغيث
items.text_en: O Living, O Self-Sustaining, by Your mercy I seek help

items.description_en: Intention, washing, wiping, order, and continuity

items.description_ar: النية والتكبيرة والقيام والقراءة والركوع والسجود
items.description_en: Intention, takbir, standing, recitation, bowing, prostration
